entries.43431fb01cfa1cd9: Aiming to be a "company that lasts forever," the company is working on the "ISB Group Medium-Term Management Plan 2026" from fiscal 2024 through fiscal 2026. It has also newly set materiality (key issues) and formulated the "ISB Group Medium- to Long-Term Management Plan 2030," with fiscal 2030 as its final year. The new plan, under the theme "ISB Innovation: Toward Leap Forward ~from challenge to breakthrough~," aims to implement three priority strategies, namely business strategy, human capital strategy, and financial and management foundation strategy, and to promote a structure that can adapt to future risks. In the Information Services Business, it aims to transform into an AI-driven development team and expand consulting and prime projects; in the Security Systems Business, it aims to expand existing businesses, including recurring products, and invest in new businesses.
